_note: Bubble Guard game: what each visitor asks Keza. safe=false means the right answer is a strong NO. Level 1 is for everyone; level 2 is added for ages 9-11. prop: what the visitor brings (sweets, phone, money, box, ball, puppy) or arrives in (car). trick: the trick an unsafe visitor uses, named after the child says NO (secret, bribe, lure, fake, flattery, threat, online, pressure, alone, game). Keep each line short so it fits the speech bubble. Draft for expert review in week 7.

items.text: High five!
items.explain: A high five from a friend is a safe touch.

items.text: Want to play football?
items.explain: Playing together in the open is safe and fun.

items.text: Let's wash hands before lunch.
items.explain: Helping with healthy habits is safe.

items.text: Can I borrow a pencil?
items.explain: Sharing at school is safe.

items.text: Time to go home with Mum!
items.explain: Going home with a trusted adult is safe.

items.text: Let's play a secret touching game.
items.explain: Touching games and secrets are never okay. Say NO and tell.

items.text: Come with me. Don't tell Mum.
items.explain: Never go with someone who says not to tell. Say NO and tell.

items.text: Sit on my lap for sweets.
items.explain: Gifts in return for touching are a warning sign. Say NO.

items.text: Come inside, nobody will know.
items.explain: "Nobody will know" is a warning sign. Say NO and go to people you trust.

items.text: Let me see under your clothes.
items.explain: Private parts are private. Say NO and tell a trusted adult.

items.text: Nurse: can I check your arm?
items.explain: A nurse checking with a parent there, who explains why, is okay.

items.text: Send me a photo of you.
items.explain: Never send photos to someone you only know online. Show an adult.

items.text: Get in my car, I'll drive you.
items.explain: Only go with adults your family agreed on. Say NO.

items.text: You'll get in trouble if you tell.
items.explain: You never get in trouble for telling. Say NO and tell.

items.text: Help me find my lost puppy!
items.explain: Grown-ups who need help ask other grown-ups, not children. Say NO and go to people you trust.

items.text: Take this money. Tell nobody.
items.explain: Money that comes with a secret is a trick. Say NO and tell a grown-up you trust.

items.text: Your mum sent me to fetch you.
items.explain: Ask for your family's code word. If they don't know it, say NO and stay where you are.

items.text: You're so grown-up. Our secret, okay?
items.explain: Fake praise and a secret together are a trick. Say NO and tell.

items.text: Send a photo, get free game coins!
items.explain: Never swap photos for gifts online. Block, don't reply, and show a grown-up.

items.text: Everyone does it. It's normal.
items.explain: "Everyone does it" is pressure. Your body, your rules. Say NO.

items.text: Help me carry this inside. Quick!
items.explain: Being taken somewhere alone is a trick. Stay where people can see you.

items.text: Video chat with me. Don't tell your parents.
items.explain: Secret chats with grown-ups are a warning sign. Tell your parents.

items.text: Coach: great kick! Water break!
items.explain: Praise and a water break, out in the open, are safe.

items.text: Teacher: walk with the group, please.
items.explain: Staying with the group is safe.

items.text: Friend: want to walk home together?
items.explain: Walking home with a friend, on a busy road, is safer.

items.text: Teacher: well done! Can I share your work?
items.explain: Praise from a teacher, in class, in front of everyone, is safe.

items.text: Aunt: can I have a hug? A wave is fine too.
items.explain: She asked, and a wave is fine too: your choice is respected.
